title: D+I Roadmap: sync live project data from the Google Sheet
description: Synced di_initiatives with the D+I Roadmap — Unified Google Sheet (ROADMAP tab): 30 updated, 12 inserted, 1 rename, 2 status transitions recorded in di_status_history, queue_position recomputed by RICE. Also fixed a schema bug: the live table had queue_number instead of the queue_position every app code path expected, and was missing size_preset entirely -- both silently broke creating/reordering queued initiatives. Did not import the sheet's CONFIG tab (obsolete per-owner WIP model, superseded by ADR-0001/0003). One DB-only row (Paid Search F180 Setup Tool) left untouched, not in current sheet.
